body: As I pick up the slumped form beside me, their weight is a comforting reminder of the connection we share. I take their fragile hand in mine, feeling a surge of compassion. My mind begins to process the situation, tracing the steps they must have taken before returning with the negative outcome. I notice the worried look in their eyes, and I think about how much they've already invested in this request. My body tenses slightly, ready to offer any support they may need.
